followUp: When would watering at noon be acceptable?

transfer.scenario: A friend grows sunberries in pots.

narration.text: I raise the bed one hand above the path.
I water the bed at noon so the berries stay cool.
I check the berries for a pale blue glow.

planted.whyWrong: Water drops focus strong light and scorch the leaves.
acceptableCorrections: I water the bed at dusk so the leaves do not scorch.

correct: water at dusk|water in the evening
